ability.name: Step 0 - Machine Context Check (Windows)
ability.description: Identify platform, hostname, domain membership, OS details, multi-homed interfaces, and parse parsed token privileges securely.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem -ErrorAction Stop; $dom = $cs.PartOfDomain; $dn = $cs.Domain; $os = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction Stop).Caption; $hn = $env:COMPUTERNAME; $privs = whoami /priv | Select-String -Pattern 'Se[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+' | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '(Se[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+)') { $Matches[1] } }; $adapters = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 } | ForEach-Object { $b = ([System.Net.IPAddress]$_.IPAddress).GetAddressBytes(); $mk = [System.BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]([Math]::Pow(2,32)-[Math]::Pow(2,32-$_.PrefixLength))); if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($mk) }; $net = (0..3|ForEach-Object{$b[$_]-band $mk[$_]}) -join '.'; "ADAPTER: $($_.InterfaceAlias)  IP: $($_.IPAddress)  CIDR: $net/$($_.PrefixLength)" }; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "OS: $os"; $adapters | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_ALL ---"; whoami /all; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_PRIV ---"; $privs | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "PRIV: $_" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/step0.txt

rationale: Required step to determine local system context, domain-join state, and parse token privileges into structured form before starting active scans.
